title: Improper input validation in Skia in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to potentially…
description: An improper input validation vulnerability exists in the Skia component of Google Chrome versions prior to 156.0.8078.79. This flaw could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the browser sandbox by delivering a crafted HTML page. The vulnerability is rated with high severity by Chromium security.
